meta.purpose: Falsification harness. A null result is the expected and correct outcome and must not be tuned away.

strategies.description: Predicts the training-set frequency of a moonshot within the horizon, ignoring all history. The reference baseline.
strategies.pnl_note: EV per unit staked is c-1 at every cashout target for a fair crash game, so a flat pnl column is the expected result.

permutation_test.interpretation: Observed skill is inside the shuffled null: no structure beyond what shuffling reproduces. This is a pass.
